title: Hub GCSE History Topic Checklist (Aligned to Edexcel 1HI0)
subtitle: Option B4: Early Elizabethan England, 1558–88

sections.title: Key topic 1: Queen, government and religion, 1558–69

topics.title: 1. The situation on Elizabeth's accession
points: Elizabethan England in 1558: **society & government**
The Virgin Queen: the problem of her **legitimacy, gender, marriage**; Her character & strengths
Challenges at home & from abroad: **financial weaknesses, religious divisions, the French threat**

topics.title: 2. The 'settlement' of religion
points: Elizabeth's **religious settlement (1559)**: its features & impact
**Church of England**: its role in society

topics.title: 3. Challenge to the religious settlement
points: Scope & impact of **Puritan challenge**
Scope & impact of **Catholic challenge** (incl. nobility, Papacy & foreign powers)

topics.title: 4. The problem of Mary, Queen of Scots
points: **Mary, Queen of Scots**: her claim to the English throne
Relations between **Elizabeth & Mary, 1568–69**

sections.title: Key topic 2: Challenges to Elizabeth at home and abroad, 1569–88

topics.title: 1. Plots and revolts at home
points: Reasons for & significance of, the **Revolt of the Northern Earls, 1569–70**
Features & significance of the **Ridolfi, Throckmorton & Babington plots**
**Walsingham** & the use of spies
Reasons for & significance of, **Mary Queen of Scots' execution in 1587**

topics.title: 2. Relations with Spain
points: Political, religious & commercial **rivalry**
Significance: **privateering** & the activities of **Drake**

topics.title: 3. Outbreak of war with Spain, 1585–88
points: Causes of deteriorating relations with Spain: English direct involvement in the **Netherlands** & the actions of **Robert Dudley**
**Drake** & the **raid on Cadiz**: 'Singeing the King of Spain's beard'

topics.title: 4. The Armada
points: Spanish **invasion plans**; Key events of the **Spanish Armada**
Reasons for the **English victory**

sections.title: Key topic 3: Elizabethan society in the Age of Exploration, 1558–88

topics.title: 1. Education and leisure
points: **Education** in the home & schools
**Sport, pastimes** & the **theatre**

topics.title: 2. The 'problem' of the poor
points: Reasons for the increase in **poverty & vagabondage** during these years
Changing **attitudes & policies** towards the poor

topics.title: 3. Exploration and voyages of discovery
points: Factors prompting exploration (incl. **new technology on ships & sailing** & the drive to **expand trade**)
Reasons for & significance of, **Drake's circumnavigation of the globe**

topics.title: 4. Attempted colonisation of Virginia
points: Causes of **attempted colonisation of Virginia** (incl. **Raleigh**)
Causes of **failure of the first settlement** in Virginia
